description: Fail-closed propagation of migrate v0 (D-101) in a src/app project: a page that renders a client component is preserved with it, a page that imports a module reading request cookies is preserved with that module, a page whose copied code dynamically imports a project file is preserved, because only static imports are rewritten, a page that already binds the generated layout name is preserved, and only the static page with its root layout and relocated module is converted; the optional dependency is kept in the generated manifest. The manifest names the real next package, so the harness creates it at test time (Q-014).
